label: PRIOR_4 requires nonmutual dependence, from the being-without bridges
meaning: Let y be PRIOR_4 to x: y can be without x and x cannot be without y. If y depended for its being on x, then by 000e1f65 y could not be without x; so y does not depend on x. If x did not depend on y, then by 8ab3d114 x could be without y, which it cannot; so it is not the case that x does not depend on y, and excluded middle (ee4ab504) gives that x depends on y. All three premises remain open; excluded middle is used once, for the one positive dependence. Conditional support option for the PRIOR_4 sibling of 47aff057.
